imageConsent.title: Third-party AI processing
imageConsent.message:
To create your look preview, we send your cropped portrait securely to Google (a third-party AI) so Gemini image editing can generate the picture you chose.

Specifically transmitted for that purpose:

• Your selected portrait crop (image pixels)

• Text describing the look option you picked

Our backend forwards this over an encrypted channel for that single request only; we do not store your selfie in our own databases.

A pseudonymous subscriber identifier may travel with the request for billing and usage limits — not your portrait as a persistent database record tied to facial analysis.

Full detail: Privacy Policy.
